name: team-grid
description: 团队介绍：三人网格（头像圈 + 名字 + 职务），逐个入场
css: #tpl-team-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 8vw; background: var(--ground, #0a0a1a); } .tg-hair { width: 64px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; opacity: .85; margin-bottom: 3vh; transform-origin: left center; } .tg-title { font-size: 4.4vh; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 5vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .tg-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4vw; } .tg-p { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1.2vh; } .tg-av { width: 12vh; height: 12vh; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); opacity: .9; } .tg-p b { font-size: 2.4vh; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); } .tg-p i { font-style: normal; font-size: 1.8vh; opacity: .6; color: var(--ink, #f0f0f5); }
body:
{{title}}
{{p1}}{{r1}}
{{p2}}{{r2}}
{{p3}}{{r3}}
timeline: tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tg-hair", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, {start});tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tg-title", { y: 34, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }, {start} + 0.2);tl.fromTo("{tpl} .tg-p", { y: 50, opacity: 0 }, { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.18 }, {start} + 0.5);
